integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically from the source resolution, Ext profile, Künneth decomposition, left-projective approximations, and a support obstruction. The checker independently verifies the finite degree/support combinatorics on a parameter grid.
scientific_limitations: Only the lower bound \(\operatorname{dell}(A_m\otimes_k A_n)\ge\min\{m,n\}+1\) is proved; no exact algebra-level value is claimed.
The base field is assumed algebraically closed, matching the motivating source.
Finite computational checks are stress tests and are not used as an infinite proof.
title: Mixed tensor products in Lam’s delooping family retain the smaller obstruction
